subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat streamed replies and continue-recent targeting

question: Should macOS Quick Chat officially expand into an in-panel streamed transcript with a temporary recent-session target?
rationale: This is a new user-facing interaction rather than a repair to an established behavior, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Sponsor the Quick Chat workflow
options.body: Accept the in-panel streamed reply and recent-targeting design once redacted native-app proof confirms the intended flow.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Retain only the capability that fits the intended Quick Chat scope and defer the other workflow.

options.title: Pause the UX change
options.body: Keep the existing Quick Chat interaction until maintainers decide the panel should become a transcript surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Quick Chat workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the in-panel streamed reply and recent-targeting design once redacted native-app proof confirms the intended flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The available branch history identifies this person as the active contributor for the proposed macOS Quick Chat design; confidence is limited because current-main history inspection was blocked.
